description: Dress a model image with upper and/or lower garment assets, supporting optional masks and original garment references.

fields.name: modelImageUrl
fields.description: Public URL of the model image.

fields.name: upperOriginUrl
fields.description: Public URL of the original upper garment image. The image must be up to 20 MB and between 385 and 4096 pixels in both width and height.

fields.name: downOriginUrl
fields.description: Public URL of the original lower garment image. The image must be up to 20 MB and between 385 and 4096 pixels in both width and height.

fields.name: upperImageUrl
fields.description: Optional processed upper garment mask or crop URL.

fields.name: downImageUrl
fields.description: Optional processed lower garment mask or crop URL.

fields.name: modelMaskImageUrl
fields.description: Optional mask URL for the model body area.

fields.name: outputNum
fields.description: Number of images to generate, from 1 to 4. Defaults to 1.
